title: It's ok
text: This tea was just ok. All the tea leaves seems to be chopped up (such as the oolong) and not very fragrant (such as the genmai). I have box of oolong that I bought in Chinatown and they dried up, whole leaves that expand when you brew it. The genmai that I also bought from Chinatown also is much more fragrant just from opening it up. This tea is probably only slightly better than some good teabags out there.
label: neutral
